behavior: Gregarious and vocal; walks rapidly over short ground cover, probing with its bill for insects and other food. Often gathers in large, coordinated flocks, nests in cavities, and readily mimics other sounds.
field_marks: Chunky body with a short tail and short, pointed wings
Long, slender, sharply pointed bill; yellow in breeding adults and dark in nonbreeding birds and juveniles
Adult plumage appears black with strong green and purple iridescence
Fresh nonbreeding plumage is densely tipped with white or cream spots
Juveniles are comparatively plain gray-brown without the adult's strong gloss
Dark eyes and pinkish-red to reddish-brown legs
habitat: Open lowland habitats with short vegetation, including grasslands, farmland, lawns, and built environments. Uses holes and crevices in trees or structures for nesting and generally avoids extensive unbroken forest and desert.
